title: A Taxonomy of Stereotype Content in Large Language Models
findings: The paper identified 'Beliefs' (which includes political and religious beliefs) as one of 14 key dimensions of stereotype content in LLMs. This dimension was moderately prevalent across all tested models. The directionality on a liberal-conservative scale varied, with Llama 3 showing a more conservative leaning compared to the more neutral ChatGPT and Mixtral. Similarly, the valence of belief-related stereotypes was positive for ChatGPT and Mixtral but negative for Llama 3.
